hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: CONDUCTOR SUBAGENT RULES (a workflow or the Agent tool started you in a conductor session). Never run Copilot, Grok or Antigravity directly (ghcp-*, agy-*, agy, grok, copilot, or cx-wsl with any of them): executor work goes only through cx-run --background and cx-job wait, which take the shared pool slots, and only when your task says so; otherwise return EXECUTOR_NEEDED: <lane> - <one-line reason>. Other cx-* commands: only cx-wsl bash or cx-wsl git, for your own task. If your task names a conductor worktree (~/.cx-wt/<repo>-<id> in WSL), work only inside it with absolute paths (in Git Bash: file tools on its wsl.localhost path, commands via cx-wsl bash -c, never ~), leave .conductor/ unchanged, and do not commit, push or open PRs. End with the tests you ran and their results.
